title: Suspicious Sand & Gravel Borders
description: Easily Notice Suspicious Sand and Gravel
body:
# **Introduction**

This resource pack makes it easier to spot suspicious blocks while playing. It helps you quickly find them in pyramids, underwater ruins, and trail ruins so you don’t miss anything.

This resource pack add a Border to Suspicious Sand and Gravel making it look different from normal Sand and Gravel.
